title_i18n.es: Simulación Mundial con Modelos Fundamentales de Vídeo para Inteligencia Artificial Física

excerpt_i18n.en: World Simulation is the core to scalable physical AI development. At CoRL 2025, NVIDIA announced major updates to Cosmos World Foundation Models (WFMs) that let developers generate diverse data for accelerating training physical AI models at scale using text, image and video prompts.

excerpt_i18n.es: La Simulación Mundial es fundamental para el desarrollo escalable de la inteligencia artificial física. En CoRL 2025, NVIDIA anunció importantes actualizaciones de los Modelos Fundacionales de Mundo Cosmos que permiten a los desarrolladores generar datos diversos para acelerar el entrenamiento.

items.title: Show HN: Sora3: Sora 3 – Next-Gen AI Video Generation Platform
items.raw_excerpt: Sora3.online is a lightweight web tool that removes watermarks from videos generated by OpenAI’s Sora model. It runs fully in the browser, with no signup or upload to third-party servers, focusing on privacy and simplicity. You just drop a video, and the AI cleans it up in minutes. The tool aims to help creators experiment freely with Sora outputs for editing, demos, and research.

title_i18n.en: Show HN: Sora3: Sora 3 – Next-Gen AI Video Generation Platform
title_i18n.zh: 展示 HN：Sora3：Sora 3——新一代人工智能视频生成平台
title_i18n.es: Mostrar HN: Sora3: Sora 3 – Plataforma de Generación de Vídeo con IA de Próxima Generación

excerpt_i18n.en: Sora3.online is a lightweight web tool that removes watermarks from videos generated by OpenAI’s Sora model. It runs fully in the browser, with no signup or upload to third-party servers, focusing on privacy and simplicity. You just drop a video, and the AI cleans it up in minutes. The tool aims to help creators experiment freely with Sora outputs for editing, demos, and research.
excerpt_i18n.zh: Sora3.online 是一款轻量级网页工具，可去除由 OpenAI 的 Sora 模型生成视频中的水印。该工具完全在浏览器中运行，无需注册或上传至第三方服务器，注重隐私保护与操作简便性。
excerpt_i18n.es: Sora3.online es una herramienta web ligera que elimina marcas de agua de videos generados por el modelo Sora de OpenAI. Funciona completamente en el navegador, sin registro ni subida a servidores de terceros, centrándose en la privacidad y la simplicidad.
